<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `12ca8b4a6af7fcd0fff8b9c3307febc8ed6235b2` — the merge of head `1df038c3ffb0b331f36d44a3cd3e3720bb37cc23` into base `af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 12ca8b4a6af7fcd0fff8b9c3307febc8ed6235b2 && git checkout 12ca8b4a6af7fcd0fff8b9c3307febc8ed6235b2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92 1df038c3ffb0b331f36d44a3cd3e3720bb37cc23 && git checkout -B drift-repro af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92 && git merge --no-ff 1df038c3ffb0b331f36d44a3cd3e3720bb37cc23

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs af90f307ca7f80b1773e34934f898fd8602ebc92` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0b2672f0ba98dc17b7b3aeebc25bfe8a31c4289c`
Local-runs: none

Run by an independent reviewer at the ceiling tier and adopted by the seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Step 0 (ruling B, 6810493176) holds for every producer in this tree.**
  - The check runs only once `kernel:ready` has settled (`isRequestKernelReady` → `hasBootPhaseSettled`), and the kernel refuses plugins after bootstrap.
  - The only `registerChannel` / `registerChannelProvider` callers are service-messaging's inbox (`init`) and its email/sms/push providers (its own `kernel:ready`).
  - `getKnownChannels()` lists providers whose transport is not configured.
  - With no messaging service, or none that can enumerate, nothing is judged, which matches the executor's no-op.
- **Doors.** POST /, PUT /:name and POST /:name/clone all persist through `registerAndSaveFlow`. Toggle and DELETE save no body.
- **Depth and reading.** Every region is walked (`collectFlowGraphs`). Channels are read exactly as `notify-node.ts` reads them (`toStringList`): an exact id match, with no aliasing.
- **Refusal and undo.** The refusal is 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`. Its message names the node, the channel and the path, with a did-you-mean and the registered roster, and `details.fields[]` carries each path. The registration is restored before anything is landed or saved: a create is withdrawn, an update keeps the held definition.
- **Boot path.** The check is not in `registrationChecks`, which is correct: package flows register before messaging's providers exist, so stored rows still boot.
- **Positions and queues.** Untouched, and documented in `flows.mdx` and `approvals.mdx`.
- **should-fix S2.** `getKnownChannels()` and its `.map` are unguarded between `registerFlow` and the save. An implementation that throws, or returns a non-array, would leave a registered-but-unsaved definition. The sibling `land()` call is guarded for exactly this. Owed this round.
- **should-fix S3.** The clone door, declared narrowed, has no dedicated pin. Owed this round.
- **should-fix S1.** The invariant now behind a 400, "a channel id exists once `kernel:ready` settles", is written nowhere on the two register methods. A late third-party registrant would be refused until it registers; no such producer exists in this tree. A docblock sentence is owed this round.
- **nit N1.** The refused definition is live across one await before the restore, the same transient the existing store-refusal path has.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is correct.
- The changeset is `@objectstack/runtime` minor and BREAKING; the title carries `!`.
- ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is correct.
- The narrowing is exact. Only a non-blank channel absent from `getKnownChannels()`, on a ready kernel with an enumerable messaging service, is refused. One declared consequence: cloning a stored flow that already names an unknown channel now answers 400.
- No new error code: `VALIDATION_FAILED` and the field code `invalid_value` both already exist.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No security or permission boundary is relaxed. The check sits after the grant, walled and locked-base refusals, and only adds a refusal.
- The roster discloses channel ids to a caller who already holds flow-authoring authority; the preference-options door exposes the same list.
- A `resolveService` failure reads as not judged, which is fail-open and matches the ruling's not-judged cases. The `getKnownChannels` throw is S2.
- PR author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay.

### ④ Design judgment

- The acceptance scenarios hold. No warning field is added, and there is no fallback to A or C.
- The pins assert code, status, path, roster, nothing saved, and the held definition kept, at depth as well. The four ablations target four distinct clauses.
- The metadata save door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME`) is not checked, and the docs and changeset say so. The seat asks #32289 to carry the same judgement there.
- The toggle door not re-checking is accepted: it persists no body.
- Note: on this head CI skipped the dogfood shards (the aggregate passed in 11 s), so the dogfood pin's execution evidence is the dev's local battery at this head (452 files passed, 3 skipped, no failures).

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `50716bc7bf786149ccb31e3ac02d05f7d064c951`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.notify-channel-unknown-refused.ts + packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-authoring-doors-durable.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-flow-clone.test.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-node-config-values-at-registration.dogfood.test.ts

Delta review of `0b2672f0..50716bc7` (patch round 1) by an isolated reviewer, adopted by the seat. The earlier PASS 6821496284 at `0b2672f0` covers the rest of the PR; the dogfood pin and the two docs pages are byte-identical since that head. Read: the delta, the card's ruling 6810493176, claim 6816678434, dev report 6821386778, release 6823270802, and the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

- **S2, the reader guard (`refuseUnknownNotifyChannels`).** `getKnownChannels()` is now called inside a `try`; a throw returns "not judged", and so does an answer that is not an array (an object, a promise). The save then goes on to `land()` and `saveMetaItem` exactly as before the check existed. This matches the ruling's not-judged class (no enumerable registry, no verdict) and the changeset now says so ("one whose channel reader throws or answers no list").
- **S2, the undo (`registerAndSaveFlow`).** The call to the check is wrapped: any throw runs `restoreFlowRegistration(automationService, name, held)` and rethrows. This is the same shape as the `land()` guard eight lines below it. After the delta no exit between `registerFlow` and the save leaves a registered-but-unsaved definition: refusal, check throw, landing refusal, landing throw and store refusal all restore.
- **S2 pins.** Pin 1 drives both reader shapes (`reader-throws`, `reader-not-a-list`) on a ready kernel with an unknown channel and asserts 200, one save, and the flow held. Pin 2 makes the boot-phase reader throw and asserts, for POST and PUT, the rejection, no save, a create withdrawn and an update holding the previous definition by identity. Ablation B1 (the reader guard) can only turn pin 1 red and B2 (the undo) only pin 2: the two clauses are pinned apart.
- **S3, the clone door.** The pin asserts status 400, `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the node and channel in the message, the roster, `details.fields` equal to `['nodes.1.config.channels']`, and that `ensureCustomizationPackage` and `saveMetaItem` were not called, the new name is not held and the source is unchanged. The control (registered channels) answers 200, saves once and holds the copy. The harness change is opt-in: the fake engine answers its definition, can withdraw a name and reads as ready only when `channels` is passed, so every earlier clone case runs on the rig it ran on before.
- **S1, the docblocks.** `registerChannel` and `registerChannelProvider` now state the invariant the 400 rests on (a channel id exists once `kernel:ready` has settled; only a provider's transport may arrive later) and name the consumer. Both sentences agree with `messaging-service-plugin.ts` (inbox in `init`, providers in its `kernel:ready` handler) and with the door. Comments only.
- **The test-source-alias fix.** `automation-flow-clone.test.ts` imports `@objectstack/metadata` at module top, so the dispatcher's function-body import is paid at collection. No assertion changes with it.
- **nit N1.** A list whose members are not `{ id: string }` is filtered, not treated as unreadable. A reader answering a list of bare strings would therefore yield an empty roster and every named channel would be refused, while a non-list answer is not judged. No implementation in this tree answers that shape (`MessagingService.getKnownChannels` is the only producer). Accepted deviation; a follow-up card may make "any unreadable member ⇒ not judged".

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` still describes the PR exactly. The delta only moves cases from "500 with a stale registration" or "refused" to "not judged", and adds no refusal.
- `'@objectstack/spec': minor` is right for the new semantic entry: it adds one D3 TODO to what `os migrate meta` prints, and the sibling `29898-picklist-binding-unknown-refused` changeset carries the same line for the same kind of file. `@objectstack/runtime` minor with **BREAKING** and the `!` title stand.
- The disposition `registered notify-channel-unknown-refused` names an id that is new in this diff, which is the form the `check-adr-0087-registration` gate prescribes for `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` since #32649; Check Changeset is `success` on this head.
- No published face moves beyond the declared narrowing: no export, barrel or `package.json` changes; no new error code (`VALIDATION_FAILED` and field code `invalid_value` exist already); the 400 answer shape and the 200 answer shape of the three doors are unchanged.
- Note for the seat's ACCEPT: `@objectstack/service-messaging` is touched by docblocks only and has no changeset line. It is in the fixed version group with `runtime` and `spec`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No permission or security boundary is relaxed. The check still runs after the grant, walled and locked-base refusals and can only add a refusal.
- The two new not-judged cases are fail-open by the ruling's design: the save behaves as it did before the PR and the run-time `channel 'NAME' not registered` outcome still reports.
- The rethrow path answers the same way a throwing `land()` already does; it adds no new answer shape.
- PR author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`18.notify-channel-unknown-refused.ts` against its sibling and its reader.** It is data only: one `SemanticMigration` with `id`, `surface`, `replacement`, `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria`, the same five fields and file shape as `18.picklist-binding-unknown-refused`, and no `conversionIds`, which is correct because no D2 conversion exists (a channel name has no mechanical rewrite, and the entry says so). The registry is generated from the files under `entries/semantic/`, so the file needs no second registration; the id is unique in the directory and kebab-case; step 18 matches its siblings.
- **Against the code.** `surface` names the three doors and "any region depth", which is what `registerAndSaveFlow` and `collectFlowGraphs` do. `reason` states the old 200, the run-time failure, the 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the did-you-mean, the roster, and that an unconfigured transport is still accepted (`getKnownChannels`, `configured: false`). `acceptanceCriteria` is a loop the consumer can run. First consumer: `os migrate meta` prints it as a TODO of the 18 hop.
- **The narrowing against the published spec on `main`.** It takes no declared capability away: the spec declares `channels` as channel names, and a name nothing registers never delivered. The door makes the run-time refusal real at the save.
- **nit N2.** The entry's `reason` lists four not-judged cases and omits two the door also has: a save before `kernel:ready` has settled, and an unreadable channel reader. It also gives the path as `nodes.N.config.channels` only; a list member answers `nodes.N.config.channels.M` and a region body a longer path. The changeset and `flows.mdx` carry the full list. Prose in a data field; a follow-up card may complete it.
- **nit N3.** The entry carries no `relevance` question, like its sibling, so it stays on the default list of a stack with no `notify` node. Allowed by the type; noted only.
- **Check-runs on this head.** 73 check runs: every one is `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core (8/8), Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness and Build Docs are `success`. The dogfood matrix shards are `skipped` on this head and the aggregate is `success`; the dev's full battery is pinned to `0b2672f0`, so the seat decides at ACCEPT whether a battery at this head is owed for the `!` title.

Findings: no must-fix, no should-fix, three nits (N1, N2, N3). S1, S2 and S3 of record 6821496284 are closed.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-32142-notify-channel-refused-at-save`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L6bhgVaKJ9TPfXPRhdqx3e`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.notify-channel-unknown-refused.ts + packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-authoring-doors-durable.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-flow-clone.test.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-node-config-values-at-registration.dogfood.test.ts

### ① Derived judgments

- **The head is a merge of main and nothing else.** `110fb294` has two parents, `50716bc7` and main `cbf6956f`; committer GitHub, signature verified. The tree a conflict-free three-way merge of the two parents yields (base `0f98e697`) has the same tree id as the commit's tree, so the merge carries no hand resolution and no extra edit.
- **The PR's own diff is unchanged.** 9 files, +538 −6, before and after. The per-file patches of `0f98e697...50716bc7` and of `main...110fb294` are byte-identical once hunk line numbers are set aside; the only movement is a +3 line offset in `automation.ts`.
- **One file is touched by both sides: `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`.** Main's hunks (#32507) add the `flow-slot-view` import, pass the address registry to `respondToFlowTrigger`, and let an addressed by-name run or read of a shared flow name be served from one holder's slot. None of them touches `refuseUnknownNotifyChannels`, `registerAndSaveFlow`, `flowWriteRefusal` or `restoreFlowRegistration`.
- **The slot view does not reach the save doors.** It is taken only when `bareByNameItem` reads the route as a flow run, read, trigger or toggle. `POST /`, `PUT /NAME` and `POST /NAME/clone` are none of those, so on a shared name they keep the `409`, as main's own comment says, and otherwise run on the bare service as at `50716bc7`. The check and its undo therefore see the same engine as before.
- **Nothing the check reads moved.** Main's 33 commits change no file under `service-messaging`, no `notify` node file, and no line naming `getKnownChannels`, `registerChannel`, `registerChannelProvider`, `isRequestKernelReady`, `hasBootPhaseSettled`, `collectFlowGraphs` or `nearestName`. Main's `http-dispatcher.ts` change (#32702) is the membership session read and leaves the kernel-ready answer alone. The channel roster and the boot fact the 400 rests on are as reviewed.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` still describe the PR exactly: the changeset is byte-identical and the accept set of the three doors is what it was at `50716bc7`.
- The disposition `registered notify-channel-unknown-refused` still holds against the gate as main now has it (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` grew by #32649 and later): the id is new in this diff, and Check Changeset and the lint gates are `success` on this head.
- No published face moves through the merge on the PR's side: no export, barrel, error code or answer shape.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No permission or security boundary is relaxed. The check still follows the grant, walled and locked-base refusals and can only add a refusal.
- Main's per-namespace flow names change who may address a shared name at the run and read doors; the write doors this PR narrows are outside that change.

### ④ Design judgment

- The design judgment of 6824007053 carries: the merge moved nothing it relied on.
- **`18.notify-channel-unknown-refused.ts`.** Byte-identical. Main added six sibling entries under `entries/semantic/`; no id in the directory repeats, and the registry is still generated from the files, so the entry needs no second registration.
- **Ordering beside main's new flow refusals.** The engine's registration still judges first, so a flow it refuses answers that refusal before the channel check, as the docblock in `registerAndSaveFlow` states.
- **Check-runs on this head.** 68 check runs, 58 `success` and 10 `skipped`, none failed or pending, Test Core (8/8), TypeScript Type Check, Lint and Repo Gates, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the Dogfood Regression Gate aggregate among the `success`. The PR reads mergeable and clean against base `cbf6956f`; main has since moved on, which the queue re-tests.

Findings: none new. The three nits of 6824007053 (N1, N2, N3) stand as recorded.

Read: the merge commit, the PR file list, the PR's diff against its base before and after, the 17 commits main brought in, and the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The head is a merge of main and nothing else.** `1df038c3` has two parents, `110fb294` and main `af90f307`; committer GitHub, signature verified. The tree a conflict-free three-way merge of the two parents yields (base `cbf6956f`) has the same tree id as the commit's tree, so the merge carries no hand resolution and no extra edit.
- **The PR's own diff is unchanged.** 9 files, +538 −6, before and after, the same nine paths. The diff of `cbf6956f` to `110fb294` and the diff of `af90f307` to `1df038c3` are byte-identical, hunk positions included: this merge moved no line in any file the PR touches.

- **What main did bring** is outside the narrowing: metadata per-package reads, history and cluster signals (#32687, #32739, #32731), the auth plugin's request surface (#32707), a security grant judgment (#32718), a computed-field backfill, UI and console fixes, two skills pages and one line of `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (#31983).

### ② Semver level

- The disposition `registered notify-channel-unknown-refused` is unchanged, and main did not touch `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` in this range.

- Main's two commits that touch access (#32707, #32718) change the auth plugin and the grant judgment, not the automation write doors or their order of refusals.

### ④ Design judgment
